item: Unverified numbers are withheld in this hub
detail: Historical hub tables displayed unconfirmed odds and ratings alongside warning badges. Labels alone did not meet the blank-unverified-values rule. All unconfirmed quantitative observations and dependent outputs are now empty cells. Raw files and metadata keys are preserved for review; no row is silently upgraded to verified.
action_requested: Independent source evidence and appropriate rights are needed before any value can be published as verified.

item: Source-link checks are not factual verification
detail: A previous checker accepted any HTTPS link in a row and unsafe hostname suffixes. The new hub gate requires a declared official-reference or project-record source with validated host/path and HTTPS. Historical citations are separate. A valid official link still does not establish that the linked source supports a value.
action_requested: Keep independent content verification separate from structural CI.

item: Legacy correlation estimates are not qualified combination evidence
detail: The former hub labelled some Pearson estimates usable based only on sample size and treated a Gaussian copula as a universal joint pricing rule. Unverified coefficients and intervals are withheld. Raw-score correlation is not residual or bet-win dependence; zero correlation does not imply independence and pairwise correlations alone do not specify a multi-leg joint distribution.
action_requested: Require authorized paired training evidence and out-of-sample joint calibration before combo pricing.

detail: NBA Terms sections 1 and 9 restrict republication and gambling-related use; the NBA Stats FAQ says statistics are not offered for download. Research-only labels do not confer permission. No live scraping or automated wagering is enabled by this repair. This is not a legal opinion.
action_requested: Remain fail-closed until appropriate permissions and legal requirements are satisfied.

item: Hub does not use a weaker two-gate leaderboard
detail: The former hub used a subset of its legacy skill gates for eligibility. The repaired hub does not adopt historical gate-pass claims or process scores. Full qualification belongs to the empirical lab's versioned all-gate protocol; all historical candidates remain unqualified and reward fields empty.
action_requested: Do not equate protocol compliance or a positive observed win rate with proven skill.

item: Earlier numerical source reads are not recertified
detail: Earlier sessions recorded official reads for some game results and standings. This repair checks local record structure and evidence boundaries only; it does not re-read those numbers or claim to have verified every historical source. Derived arithmetic can reproduce an incorrect input.
action_requested: Raw historical evidence remains linked; numeric values stay blank here.

item: Other sections retain their own evidence standards
detail: This narrow non-overlapping repair covers docs/hub and its checker only. Earlier source-archive and model-prototype pages can still display historical unverified values or unsupported gate claims. Those sections and other sessions' active PR scopes were preserved. Their source links do not certify the adjacent data.
action_requested: Treat linked legacy sites as review archives rather than verified feeds.
